s: Zarathustra declared unworthy of sacrifice and prayer creation of the Daêvas (first in the material world)
q: who first in the material world declared all the creation of the Daêvas unworthy of sacrifice and prayer;

s: Zarathustra is a first bearer of the Law amongst the nations (strong and giving all the good things of life)
q: who was strong, giving all the good things of life, the first bearer of the Law amongst the nations;

s: Zarathustra contains Word of holiness (the whole Mãthra was heard in him)
q: In whom was heard the whole Mãthra, the word of holiness;

s: Zarathustra is a lord and master of the world
q: who was the lord and master of the world, the praiser of the most great, most good and most fair Asha;

s: Zarathustra praises Asha (most great, most good and most fair)
q: who was the lord and master of the world, the praiser of the most great, most good and most fair Asha;

s: Zarathustra has revelation of law of Ahura (most excellent of all beings)
q: who had a revelation of the Law, that most excellent of all beings;

s: Zarathustra is longed for by Amesha-Spentas (in one accord with the sun and in the fulness of faith)
q: For whom the Amesha-Spentas longed, in one accord with the sun, in the fulness of faith of a devoted heart;

s: Zarathustra is born as Âthravan (Spitama Zarathustra)
q: 'Hail to us! for he is born, the Âthravan, Spitama Zarathustra.

s: Zarathustra offers sacrifice (with libations and bundles of baresma)
q: Zarathustra will offer us sacrifices with libations and bundles of baresma;

s: Fravashis of the faithful is holy holy
q: who are undecaying and holy;

s: Vîstâspa is a holy king (gallant, incarnate Word, mighty-speared, and lordly)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy king Vîstâspa; the gallant one, who was the incarnate Word, the mighty-speared, and lordly one;

s: Vîstâspa supports law of Ahura (arm and support)
q: who made himself the arm and support of this law of Ahura, of this law of Zarathustra.

s: Vîstâspa supports law of Zarathustra (arm and support)
q: who made himself the arm and support of this law of Ahura, of this law of Zarathustra.

s: Daêvas is unworthy of sacrifice and prayer
q: who first in the material world declared all the creation of the Daêvas unworthy of sacrifice and prayer;

s: Daêvas is destroyed by law of Ahura (through Zarathustra's word)
q: Who first in the material world said the word that destroys the Daêvas, the law of Ahura;

s: Asha is a most great, most good and most fair principle
q: who was the lord and master of the world, the praiser of the most great, most good and most fair Asha;

s: law of Ahura is a word that destroys the Daêvas
q: Who first in the material world said the word that destroys the Daêvas, the law of Ahura;

s: Amesha-Spentas is a seven beings (of one thought, speech, and deed)
q: Who are all seven of one thought, who are all seven of one speech, who are all seven of one deed; whose thought is the same, whose speech is the same, whose deed is the same, whose father and commander is the same, namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda;

s: law of Zarathustra is supported by Vîstâspa (as arm and support)
q: who made himself the arm and support of this law of Ahura, of this law of Zarathustra.

s: good Law of the worshippers of Mazda spreads through seven Karshvares of the earth
q: and there will the good Law of the worshippers of Mazda come and spread through all the seven Karshvares of the earth.

s: Mithra is a lord of wide pastures
q: That of Mithra, the lord of wide pastures;

s: Sraosha is a incarnate Word (holy, strong, mighty-speared, and lordly god)
q: and that of the holy, strong Sraosha, who is the incarnate Word, a mighty-speared and lordly god;

s: Ashi Vanguhi is a maid (fair of body, most strong, tall-formed, high-up girded, pure, nobly born of a glorious seed)
q: In whose house did walk the good, beautiful, shining Ashi Vanguhi, in the shape of a maid fair of body, most strong, tall-formed, high-up girded, pure, nobly born of a glorious seed;

s: Amesha-Spentas has father and commander Ahura Mazda (the Maker)
q: whose father and commander is the same, namely, the Maker, Ahura Mazda;

s: Amesha-Spentas thinks of good thoughts (one another's soul thinking of)
q: Who see one another's soul thinking of good thoughts, thinking of good words, thinking of good deeds, thinking of Garô-nmâna, and whose ways are shining as they go down towards the libations.

s: Amesha-Spentas thinks of good words (one another's soul thinking of)
q: Who see one another's soul thinking of good thoughts, thinking of good words, thinking of good deeds, thinking of Garô-nmâna, and whose ways are shining as they go down towards the libations.

s: Amesha-Spentas thinks of good deeds (one another's soul thinking of)
q: Who see one another's soul thinking of good thoughts, thinking of good words, thinking of good deeds, thinking of Garô-nmâna, and whose ways are shining as they go down towards the libations.

s: Fravashis of the faithful is a Fravashis (awful and overpowering)
q: The Fravashis of the faithful, awful and overpowering, awful and victorious;

s: Zarathustra is worthy of glorification (amongst all beings)
q: the most worthy of glorification amongst all beings,

s: holy men and women struggle for Holiness (past, present, or future)
q: We worship the souls of the holy men and women, born at any time, whose consciences struggle, or will struggle, or have struggled, for the good.

s: holy men and women teach law of Ahura (those who struggle, will struggle, or have struggled)
q: We worship the spirit, conscience, perception, soul, and Fravashi of the holy men and holy women who struggle, will struggle, or have struggled, and teach the Law,

s: the men of the primitive law is in houses (future, past, and present occupants)
q: We worship the men of the primitive law who will be in these houses, boroughs, towns, and countries; We worship the men of the primitive law who have been in these houses, boroughs, towns, and countries; We worship the men of the primitive law who are in these houses, boroughs, towns, and countries.

s: the men of the primitive law obtains Holiness (in all houses, boroughs, towns, and countries)
q: We worship the men of the primitive law in all houses, boroughs, towns, and countries, who obtained these houses, who obtained these boroughs, who obtained these towns, who obtained these countries, who obtained holiness, who obtained the Mãthra, who obtained the [blessedness of the] soul, who obtained all the perfections of goodness.

s: the men of the primitive law obtains Mãthra (in all houses, boroughs, towns, and countries)
q: We worship the men of the primitive law in all houses, boroughs, towns, and countries, who obtained these houses, who obtained these boroughs, who obtained these towns, who obtained these countries, who obtained holiness, who obtained the Mãthra, who obtained the [blessedness of the] soul, who obtained all the perfections of goodness.

s: the men of the primitive law obtains all the perfections of goodness
q: who obtained all the perfections of goodness.

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô is a law of holiness (will of the Lord)
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Ashem Vohû is a Holiness (best of all good)
q: Ashem Vohû.: Holiness is the best of all good. . . .

s: earth is worthy of sacrifice (worshipped)
q: We worship this earth;

s: Gaopi-vanghu has fravashi Fravashis of the faithful (holy)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy Gaopi-vanghu.

s: ASTVAT-ERETA is a SAOSHYANT (victorious future figure)
q: Whose name will be the victorious SAOSHYANT and whose name will be Astvat-ereta. He will be SAOSHYANT (the Beneficent One), because he will benefit the whole bodily world; he will be ASTVAT-ERETA (he who makes the bodily creatures rise up), because as a bodily creature and as a living creature he will stand against the destruction of the bodily creatures, to withstand the Drug of the two-footed brood, to withstand the evil done by the faithful.

s: SAOSHYANT benefits the material world (whole future bodily world)
q: He will be SAOSHYANT (the Beneficent One), because he will benefit the whole bodily world;

s: ASTVAT-ERETA makes rise up bodily creatures (as a bodily creature and as a living creature)
q: he will be ASTVAT-ERETA (he who makes the bodily creatures rise up), because as a bodily creature and as a living creature he will stand against the destruction of the bodily creatures,

s: ASTVAT-ERETA withstands the Drug (the Drug of the two-footed brood)
q: to withstand the Drug of the two-footed brood,

s: ASTVAT-ERETA withstands evil (evil done by the faithful)
q: to withstand the evil done by the faithful.

s: Yima is son of Vîvanghant (holy)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy Yima, the son of Vîvanghant;

s: Yima is a valiant (with flocks at his wish)
q: the valiant Yima, who had flocks at his wish;

s: Yima withstands Daêvas (oppression caused by the Daêvas)
q: to stand against the oppression caused by the Daêvas,

s: Yima withstands drought (drought that destroys pastures)
q: against the drought that destroys pastures,

s: Yima withstands death (death that creeps unseen)
q: and against death that creeps unseen.

s: Thraêtaona is a holy (of the Âthwya house)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy Thraêtaona, of the Âthwya house;

s: Thraêtaona withstands humours
q: to stand against itch, hot fever, humours, cold fever, and incontinency,

s: Thraêtaona withstands cold fever
q: to stand against itch, hot fever, humours, cold fever, and incontinency,

s: Thraêtaona withstands incontinency
q: to stand against itch, hot fever, humours, cold fever, and incontinency,

s: Thraêtaona withstands Serpent (evil done by the Serpent)
q: to stand against the evil done by the Serpent.

s: Husravah is a king (holy)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy king Husravah;

s: Keresâspa is a Sâma (club-bearer with plaited hair)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy Keresâspa, the Sâma, the club-bearer with plaited hair;

s: Keresâspa withstands brigand (dreadful brigand who works destruction)
q: to withstand the dreadful brigand who works destruction, the man-slayer who has no mercy;

s: Keresâspa withstands evil (evil done by the brigand)
q: to withstand the evil done by the brigand.

s: Âkhrûra is son of Husravah
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy Âkhrûra, the son of Husravah;

s: Haoshyangha is a gallant (holy)
q: We worship the Fravashi of the holy and gallant Haoshyangha;

s: Haoshyangha withstands Mâzainya Daêvas
q: To withstand the Mâzainya Daêvas and the Varenya fiends;

s: Haoshyangha withstands Varenya fiends
q: To withstand the Mâzainya Daêvas and the Varenya fiends;

s: Vîspa-taurvairi brings forth SAOSHYANT (who will destroy the malice of Daêvas and men)
q: She is Vîspa-taurvairi (the all-destroying) because she will bring him forth, who will destroy the malice of Daêvas and men,

s: holy men and women is in Aryan nations (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in the Aryan countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in the Aryan countries.

s: holy men and women is in Turanian countries (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in the Turanian countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in the Turanian countries.

s: holy men and women is in Sairimyan countries (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in the Sairimyan countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in the Sairimyan countries.

s: holy men and women is in Sâini countries (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in the Sâini countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in the Sâini countries.

s: holy men and women is in Dâhi countries (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in the Dâhi countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in the Dâhi countries.

s: holy men and women is in all countries (men and women)
q: We worship the Fravashis of the holy men in all countries; We worship the Fravashis of the holy women in all countries.

s: Fravashis of the faithful descend from Gaya Maretan (down to the victorious Saoshyant)
q: We worship all the good, awful, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful, from Gaya Maretan down to the victorious Saoshyant.

s: Fravashis of the faithful is a beneficent (good and awful)
q: We worship all the good, awful, beneficent Fravashis of the faithful,

s: Fravashis of the faithful is protected by Ahura Mazda (with manifest assistance)
q: They protect us when in distress with manifest assistance, with the assistance of Ahura Mazda and of the holy, powerful Sraosha,

s: Fravashis of the faithful is protected by Sraosha (holy and powerful assistance)
q: They protect us when in distress with manifest assistance, with the assistance of Ahura Mazda and of the holy, powerful Sraosha,

s: Sraosha is a holy (powerful)
q: with the assistance of Ahura Mazda and of the holy, powerful Sraosha,

s: Zarathustra worships Mãthra-Spenta (greatly in the material world)
q: a friend of Ahura Mazda, whom Zarathustra worshipped so greatly in the material world.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker
q: May they carry back from here hymns and worship to the Maker, Ahura Mazda, and the Amesha-Spentas!

s: Amesha-Spentas is worshipped by Fravashis of the faithful (through hymns and worship carried back)
q: May they carry back from here hymns and worship to the Maker, Ahura Mazda, and the Amesha-Spentas!

s: Zarathustra is a man of the primitive law (lord and master of all the material world)
q: We worship Zarathustra, the lord and master of all the material world, the man of the primitive law;

s: Zarathustra is a wisest (of all beings)
q: the wisest of all beings, the best-ruling of all beings, the brightest of all beings, the most glorious of all beings,

s: Zarathustra is a best-ruling (of all beings)
q: the wisest of all beings, the best-ruling of all beings, the brightest of all beings, the most glorious of all beings,

s: Zarathustra is a brightest (of all beings)
q: the wisest of all beings, the best-ruling of all beings, the brightest of all beings, the most glorious of all beings,

s: Zarathustra is a most glorious (of all beings)
q: the wisest of all beings, the best-ruling of all beings, the brightest of all beings, the most glorious of all beings,

s: Zarathustra is worthy of sacrifice (amongst all beings)
q: the most worthy of sacrifice amongst all beings,

s: Zarathustra is worthy of prayer (amongst all beings)
q: the most worthy of prayer amongst all beings,

s: Zarathustra is worthy of propitiation (amongst all beings)
q: the most worthy of propitiation amongst all beings,

s: Haoma is a victorious protector (saves one's head and protects the body)
q: I offer up Haoma, who saves one's head; I offer up the victorious Haoma; I offer him up, the good protector; I offer up Haoma, who is a protector to my body, as a man who shall drink of him shall win and prevail over his enemies in battle;

s: Haoma gives victory (to one who drinks it in battle)
q: as a man who shall drink of him shall win and prevail over his enemies in battle;

s: Angra Mainyu creates Azi Dahâka (as a powerful fiendish Drug against the material world)
q: that most powerful, fiendish Drug, that demon, baleful to the world, the strongest Drug that Angra Mainyu created against the material world, to destroy the world of the good principle.

s: Thraêtaona rides Vârengana (as a gallant rider)
q: Him rode the gallant Thraêtaona, who smote Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who had a thousand senses;

s: Thraêtaona smote Azi Dahâka (defeated the powerful fiendish Drug)
q: Him rode the gallant Thraêtaona, who smote Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed, who had a thousand senses;

s: Mithra is associated with Rashnu (travels with Verethraghna among armies)
q: who goes along the armies arrayed, and goes here and there asking, along with Mithra and Rashnu: 'Who is it who lies unto Mithra? Who is it who thrusts [his oath] against Rashnu?

s: Rashnu is associated with Mithra (travels with Verethraghna among armies)
q: who goes along the armies arrayed, and goes here and there asking, along with Mithra and Rashnu: 'Who is it who lies unto Mithra? Who is it who thrusts [his oath] against Rashnu?

s: Ahura Mazda creates Verethraghna, made by Ahura (as a heavenly god)
q: It is Verethraghna, made by Ahura, O Spitama Zarathustra!

s: Aryan nations offer sacrifice (to Verethraghna according to the perfection of holiness)
q: If men sacrifice unto Verethraghna, made by Ahura, if the due sacrifice and prayer is offered unto him just as it ought to be performed in the perfection of holiness, never will a hostile horde enter the Aryan countries, nor any plague, nor leprosy, nor venomous plants, nor the chariot of a foe, nor the uplifted spear of a foe.

s: Aryan nations bring libations (to Verethraghna)
q: Let the Aryan nations bring libations unto him; let the Aryan nations tie bundles of baresma for him; let the Aryan nations cook for him a head of cattle, either white, or black, or of any other colour, but all of one and the same colour.

s: Daêvas withstands good Law of the worshippers of Mazda
q: who does not sing the Gâthâs, who spreads death in the world and withstands the law of Mazda, the law of Zarathustra.

s: Strength is a keeper (good keeper and maintainer)
q: I will bless Strength and Victory, the two keepers, the two good keepers, the two maintainers;

s: Victory is a keeper (good keeper and maintainer)
q: I will bless Strength and Victory, the two keepers, the two good keepers, the two maintainers;

s: sacrifice is a ritual offering (performed for Verethraghna in holiness)
q: if the due sacrifice and prayer is offered unto him just as it ought to be performed in the perfection of holiness

s: the struggle against evil is a armed conflict (armies meet in full array)
q: When armies meet together in full array, O Spitama Zarathustra!

s: Ashem Vohû means Holiness is the best of all good
q: Ashem Vohû: Holiness is the best of all good . . . .

s: Zarathustra is a worshipper of Mazda (follower of Zarathustra and hater of the Daêvas)
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra, one who hates the Daêvas and obeys the laws of Ahura;

s: Yathâ ahû vairyô means The will of the Lord is the law of holiness
q: Yathâ ahû vairyô: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness . . . .

s: Zarathustra asks Ahura Mazda (asks about Verethraghna and remedies)
q: Zarathustra asked Ahura Mazda: 'Ahura Mazda, most beneficent Spirit, Maker of the material world, thou Holy One!

s: Vârengana is a bird (strong bird with feathers)
q: Take thou a feather of that bird with . . . . feathers, the Vârengana, O Spitama Zarathustra!

s: Vârengana provides feathers (used as protective talismans)
q: If a man holds a bone of that strong bird, or a feather of that strong bird, no one can smite or turn to flight that fortunate man.

s: Vârengana brings help (to the person holding its feather or bone)
q: The feather of that bird of birds brings him help; it brings unto him the homage of men, it maintains in him his glory.

s: Vârengana maintains Glory (in the person holding its feather)
q: The feather of that bird of birds brings him help; it brings unto him the homage of men, it maintains in him his glory.

s: Ahura Mazda is a Maker
q: To him did the Maker, Ahura Mazda, offer up a sacrifice in the Airyana Vaêgah 1

s: Vayu works highly highly
q: Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon

s: Vayu is powerful to afflict more powerful than all other creatures
q: Vayu who works highly and is more powerful to afflict than all other creatures

s: Vayu belongs to Spenta Mainyu (the part belonging to)
q: To this part of thee do we sacrifice, O Vayu! that belongs to Spenta Mainyu.

s: Vayu belongs to Good Spirit (the part belonging to)
q: To this part of thee do we sacrifice, O Vayu! that belongs to the Good Spirit.

s: Vayu goes through two worlds (both worlds)
q: My name is Vayu, because I go through (vyêmi) the two worlds, the one which the Good Spirit has made and the one which the Evil Spirit has made.

s: Vayu is a Overtaker
q: My name is the Overtaker (apaêta), O holy Zarathustra!

s: Vayu is a All-smiting
q: My name is the All-smiting, O holy Zarathustra!

s: Vayu is a Worker of Good
q: My name is the Worker of Good, O holy Zarathustra!

s: Vayu is a Valiant
q: My name is the Valiant; my name is the Most Valiant.

s: Vayu is a Strong
q: My name is the Strong; my name is the Strongest.

s: Vayu is a Firm
q: My name is the Firm; my name is the Firmest.

s: Vayu is a Stout
q: My name is the Stout; my name is the Stoutest.

s: Vayu is a golden helm (wearing)
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden helm.

s: Vayu is a golden crown (wearing)
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden crown.

s: Vayu is a golden necklace (wearing)
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden necklace.

s: Vayu possesses golden chariot
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden chariot.

s: Vayu possesses golden wheel
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden wheel.

s: Vayu possesses golden weapons
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden weapons.

s: Vayu wears golden garment
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden garment.

s: Vayu wears golden shoe
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden shoe.

s: Vayu wears golden girdle
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden girdle.

s: Vayu is worshipped by Ahura Mazda (through sacrifice)
q: To him did the Maker, Ahura Mazda, offer up a sacrifice in the Airyana Vaêgah 1

s: Vayu grants boon (to worthy sacrificers)
q: Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon, as the Maker, Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.

s: Angra Mainyu is a Evil Spirit
q: the one which the Evil Spirit has made

s: Angra Mainyu creates Drug (the strongest Drum created against the material world)
q: the strongest Drum that Angra Mainyu created against the material world

s: Daêvas belong to Mâzana
q: two-thirds of the Daêvas of Mâzana and of the fiends of Varena

s: Daêvas are hated by Zarathustra
q: one who hates the Daêvas

s: Daêvas are worked against by Vayu (in all creatures)
q: who in all creatures workest against the Daêvas

s: Zarathustra is a worshipper of Mazda
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra

s: Yima is a good shepherd (bright)
q: Unto him did the bright Yima, the good shepherd, sacrifice

s: Yima is a most glorious of the men born to behold the sun (desired status)
q: that I may become the most glorious of the men born to behold the sun

s: Yima rules animals (in a reign of abundance)
q: that I may make in my reign both animals and men undying

s: Yima rules men (in a reign of abundance)
q: that I may make in my reign both animals and men undying

s: Yima rules waters (undrying)
q: that I may make in my reign both animals and men undying, waters and plants undrying

s: Yima rules plants (undrying)
q: that I may make in my reign both animals and men undying, waters and plants undrying

s: Yima has food for eating creatures (never-failing in his reign)
q: and the food for eating creatures never-failing.

s: Azi Dahâka is a three-mouthed Drug (fiendish and baleful to the world)
q: the three-mouthed Azi Dahâka

s: Azi Dahâka is a three-headed
q: Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed

s: Zarathustra is a follower of Zarathustra
q: I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathustra

s: Azi Dahâka is a six-eyed
q: Azi Dahâka, the three-mouthed, the three-headed, the six-eyed

s: Azi Dahâka has a thousand senses
q: who has a thousand senses

s: Azi Dahâka is a strongest Drum (created by Angra Mainyu against the material world)
q: the strongest Drum that Angra Mainyu created against the material world

s: Thraêtaona is a heir of the valiant Âthwya clan
q: Unto him did Thraêtaona, the heir of the valiant Âthwya clan, offer up a sacrifice

s: Keresâspa is a manly-hearted
q: To him did the manly-hearted Keresâspa offer up a sacrifice

s: Zarathustra hates Daêvas
q: one who hates the Daêvas

s: Husravah is a king (gallant and unifier of the Aryan nations)
q: that the gallant Husravah, he who unites the Aryan nations into one kingdom

s: Husravah unites Aryan nations (into one kingdom)
q: that the gallant Husravah, he who unites the Aryan nations into one kingdom

s: Hutaosa is a woman of the Naotara house (she of the many brothers)
q: To him did Hutaosa, she of the many brothers, of the Naotara house, offer up a sacrifice

s: Hutaosa is a member of Naotara house
q: of the Naotara house

s: Vîstâspa is a king (the house in which Hutaosa seeks acceptance)
q: that I may be dear and loved and well-received in the house of king Vîstâspa.

s: Zarathustra obeys Ahura Mazda (the laws of)
q: and obeys the laws of Ahura

s: Aryan nations are united by Husravah (into one kingdom)
q: that the gallant Husravah, he who unites the Aryan nations into one kingdom

s: Vayu is a God (excellent)
q: To this excellent God do we sacrifice

s: Naotara house contains Hutaosa (her house)
q: Hutaosa, she of the many brothers, of the Naotara house

s: Waters are invoked with Vayu (in sacrifice)
q: I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them. I will sacrifice to Peace, whose breath is friendly, and to Weal, both of them. To this Vayu do we sacrifice

s: Haoma is used in sacrifice (as an offering to Vayu)
q: We offer up a sacrifice unto the awful Vayu, who works highly, with the libations, with the Haoma and meat

s: baresma is used in sacrifice (as a ritual offering)
q: with the libations, with the Haoma and meat, with the baresma

s: sacrifice is offered to Vayu (for propitiation and glorification)
q: For sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification unto [Hâvani], the holy and master of holiness

s: sacrifice is offered by Ahura Mazda (to Vayu)
q: To him did the Maker, Ahura Mazda, offer up a sacrifice in the Airyana Vaêgah 1

s: Glory is given to man (as a blessing)
q: [Give] unto that man brightness and glory

s: Vayu is a holy Vayu
q: We sacrifice to the holy Vayu

s: golden throne is used for sacrifice (ritual seat)
q: on a golden throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy

s: golden chariot is possessed by Vayu
q: We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden chariot.

s: golden weapons are possessed by Vayu
